facts.fact: INSTAT lists the Annuaire du commerce international des marchandises 2022 and 2023 (exports and imports by chapter and country) among the national statistical system's publications of the fourth quarter of 2025; no exact release date is given, so the bulletin's date of 20 January 2026 is used.
facts.system: Annuaire du commerce international des marchandises 2022 and 2023

facts.fact: INSTAT lists the Bulletin des statistiques du commerce international des marchandises for the second quarter of 2025 among the publications of the fourth quarter of 2025; no exact release date is given, so the bulletin's date of 20 January 2026 is used.
facts.system: Bulletin des statistiques du commerce international des marchandises, T2 2025

facts.fact: The regional statistics directorate (DRPSIAP) of Sikasso published the regional statistical yearbooks 2023 and 2024 in December 2025, consolidating statistics drawn from administrative data collected from technical services together with survey and census data.
facts.system: Annuaires statistiques 2023 et 2024 de la région de Sikasso

facts.fact: The Gao regional statistics directorate (DRPSIAP-Gao) is listed as publishing the regional statistical yearbooks 2023 and 2024 in the fourth quarter of 2025, after a validation workshop on 13-14 November 2025 supported by UNICEF; no exact release date is given, so the bulletin's date of 20 January 2026 is used.
facts.system: Annuaires statistiques 2023 et 2024 de la région de Gao

facts.fact: The Observatoire du Transport's steering committee examined and validated the transport statistical yearbooks 2023 and 2024 on 29 December 2025, and they are listed among the publications of the fourth quarter of 2025.
